[Section] Level B: Categorization of Offensive Language
[source_id=23] Level B categorizes the type of offense and two labels are used: targeted (TIN) and untargeted (INT) insults and threats.
[source_id=24] Targeted Insult (TIN): Posts which contain an insult/threat to an individual, group, or others (see next layer);
[source_id=25] Untargeted (UNT): Posts containing non-targeted profanity and swearing. Posts with general profanity are not targeted, but they contain non-acceptable language.
